{{Top|leg}}
An '''X-wing simulator''' was a machine used by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to simulate flying an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]], usually for training and learning purposes. The simulator also has an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[Astromech socket/Legends|slot]] where pilots could plug their droids in, even though the machine is capable of simulating astromech instructions. By using their own astromechs, it allowed them to have a more realistic training experience.<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

The [[Skipchaser]] simulation was used during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] to show pilots what it was like to fight [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]].
